description: Creates a word, or updates an existing word when itemId and expectedVersion are both provided. Matching text alone never updates an existing word. Updates are patches: omitted fields stay unchanged and null clears supported fields. definitions edits a meaning by ID or adds one without an ID; removeDefinitionIds deletes those meanings with their examples and meaning progress; removing every meaning keeps the word. Each retained meaning needs definition text or a translation. appendExamples keeps existing examples, replaceExamples replaces them ([] clears), and the two cannot be combined. addGroupIds and removeGroupIds change only the listed memberships. imageUrl accepts a durable public HTTPS image URL; null removes the image. requestId makes retries idempotent when the input is identical. Subject to the plan's word limit.

definitions.description: Meaning patches. An existing definition ID edits that meaning; an entry without an ID adds a meaning. Omitted meanings and fields stay unchanged.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque revision token from the latest read or save of this item. A stale token returns WORD_CHANGED or GROUP_CHANGED without saving.

imageUrl.description: Durable public HTTPS URL of the image to set, or null to remove the image. Omitted keeps the current image.

itemId.description: ID of an existing word to update. Omit, together with expectedVersion, to create a word.

languageCode.description: Code of the learning language, for example en-GB or es-ES.

name: save_word
title: Save a word
